# Proto-Dawi
Despite the difficulties it brings, Proto-Dawi are typically too prideful to even THINK about shaving their beard to better fit their newfound visor. As such, they are the only race that can be seen sporting a beard ontop of their visor.
## Racial Features - Their blood has a dark red color. - They [color=#1e90ff]handle alcohol better[/color], requiring more to get drunk. - They are [color=#1e90ff]slightly healed by alcohol[/color]. - They are able to take [color=#1e90ff]110 damage before falling into a critical state, dying once they reach 220 damage[/color]. - They receive [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1e90ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Grumbakul and Trinary The Dwarf language, known as Grumbakul, is composed of gutteral grunts not too dissimilar to the humans's own language. It is described as simple and effective, easy to learn and even easier to speak. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names A Dwarf's lifespan is almost identical to that of a human, reaching adulthood at 18 years of age and living until 150. Dwarven names are also almost the same as the ones used by humans.
